title: Decision-point counting
responsibility: Counts the supported code and Svelte template decision markers used for complexity measurements.

inputs.name: templateComplexity.markup
inputs.description: Markup string scanned for decision markers. The matcher recognizes `{#if`, `{#each`, or `{#await` followed by a word boundary, and `{:else if` followed by a word boundary; other constructs do not add to the count.
examples: {#if ready}{:else if fallback}{/if}{#each items as item}{/each}{#await promise}{/await}

inputs.name: blockComplexity.masked
inputs.description: Source text after comments and string contents have been masked. Matching is textual; this function does not mask or parse the source itself.
examples: if (ready && fallback) return value ?? defaultValue; return active ? yes : no;

inputs.name: blockComplexity.base
inputs.description: Initial count added for the function being measured, or zero when no function base is needed. The type permits only 0 or 1.

outputs.name: blockComplexity
outputs.description: Number equal to `base` plus matches of whole-word `if`, `for`, `while`, `case`, `catch`, `&&`, `||`, `??`, and eligible `?` characters in `masked`. A lone `?` is skipped after `?` or before `?`, `.`, `:`, `,`, `)`, `]`, `=`, `>`, or `;`.

outputs.name: templateComplexity
outputs.description: Number of occurrences matched by the template decision-marker regex. It counts each matching marker once and returns zero when none are present; it does not parse or validate the markup.
